title: Media God Fire TV
message: Fire TV 1.4.18 adds device-aware codec and container preflight. Media God now checks the Fire TV's installed decoders and source hints before playback, keeps supported H.264/HEVC/VP9/AV1 and other formats on fast Media3 hardware decoding, and opens the broad compatibility engine immediately for unsupported or legacy codecs/containers such as DTS/DTS-HD, TrueHD/MLP, VC-1, DivX/Xvid, AVI/WMV/FLV and other difficult media where appropriate.
